mapper.sql: SELECT row_number() OVER(ORDER BY icam06_std_date DESC) AS fund_book_id , icam06_std_date AS std_date , SUM(icam06_principal) AS principal , SUM(icam06_nav) AS nav , SUM(icam06_total_asset) AS total_asset , f_calc_FundBookAvg(icam06_company_id, icam06_std_date, '1', #{fundType}) AS nav_avg , f_calc_FundBookAvg(icam06_company_id, icam06_std_date, '2', #{fundType}) AS total_asset_avg FROM ( SELECT icam06_std_date , icam06_fund_cd , icam06_fund_nm , icam06_multi_class_cd , icam06_principal , icam06_nav , icam06_total_asset , sys01_company_id AS icam06_company_id FROM icam06_fund_book INNER JOIN sys01_company ON ( sys01_icam_company_cd = icam06_icam_company_cd AND sys01_company_id = #{companyId} ) WHERE icam06_std_date BETWEEN #{startDate}::date AND #{closeDate}::date UNION ALL SELECT ifi32_std_date::date AS icam06_std_date , ifi32_fund_cd AS icam06_fund_cd , ifi32_fund_nm AS icam06_fund_nm , ifi32_multi_class_func_cd AS icam06_multi_class_cd , ifi32_principal AS icam06_principal , ifi32_nav AS icam06_nav , ifi32_total_asset AS icam06_total_asset , ifi29_company_id AS icam06_company_id FROM ifi32_fund_price INNER JOIN ifi29_am_corp_mapping ON ( ifi29_if_cd = ifi32_if_cd AND ifi29_am_corp_cd = ifi32_am_corp_cd AND ifi32_std_date BETWEEN TO_CHAR(ifi29_start_date,'YYYYMMDD') AND COALESCE(TO_CHAR(ifi29_end_date,'YYYYMMDD'),'99991231') ) WHERE ifi29_company_id = #{companyId} AND ifi32_cur_cd = 'KRW' AND ifi32_std_date BETWEEN TO_CHAR(#{startDate}::date,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(#{closeDate}::date,'YYYYMMDD') ) t WHERE ( ( #{fundType} = '1' AND /*(1:운용펀드)*/ icam06_fund_cd = (CASE WHEN COALESCE(icam06_multi_class_cd,'') != '' THEN icam06_multi_class_cd ELSE icam06_fund_cd END) ) OR ( #{fundType} = '2' AND /*(2:판매펀드)*/ icam06_fund_cd != COALESCE(icam06_multi_class_cd, '') ) ) AND UPPER(CONCAT(icam06_fund_cd, icam06_fund_nm)) ILIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) GROUP BY icam06_std_date, icam06_company_id
